industry.headline: Families of four teens sue Meta, TikTok, Snap and YouTube over suicide deaths
industry.summary: Four families across Texas, North Carolina, Minnesota and Tennessee filed suit in Delaware alleging years of escalating platform-driven harm led to their teens' deaths, part of a growing wave of addictive-design litigation against major platforms. Reinforces the liability narrative underpinning NOMO's US GTM pitch to schools and brands.

industry.headline: New York finalizes SAFE for Kids Act rules: age verification and default-off algorithmic feeds for minors
industry.summary: New York's finalized rules require platforms to verify age and get parental consent before showing algorithmic feeds to under-18s, starting January 2027, turning addictive feeds off by default. A concrete US state framework validating NOMO's core value proposition and a potential template for other states.

industry.headline: Florida teen drops bellwether Meta addiction case after settling with YouTube, Snap and TikTok
industry.summary: A Florida plaintiff settled with three of four defendants and dropped his case against Meta, with the Tennessee AG trial against Meta now the next major liability test. Pre-trial settlements suggest platforms are pricing in addiction-design risk, bolstering NOMO's brand-safe alternative positioning in the US.

industry.headline: Australia's under-16 social media ban shows enforcement gaps as UK weighs similar rules
industry.summary: 61% of under-16 Australians report little change in usage despite the ban, and eSafety continues probing Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, TikTok and YouTube for non-compliance as the UK studies the model. Directly relevant to the policy environment shaping NOMO's UK pilot and Leonardo's cross-market influence (UK/US/AU).

industry.headline: UAE-based Bundle raises $5.5M pre-seed for Web3 brand rewards platform
industry.summary: Bundle's pilot across five brands and markets distributed $100K in prizes and drove up to 4x higher conversion than traditional incentive campaigns, with plans to scale into Southeast Asia. Not youth-focused, but a useful benchmark validating the brand-funded prize model NOMO's partnerships rely on.
